references.body_text: This Monday we're starting a 10 minute walk to run challenge. You begin by walking, and your coach adds a little running each week until you run your first mile. No gym and no running experience needed.

Calling all country-loving ladies over 50. Our walk to run challenge starts with 10 minute walks to your favorite country songs, and a real coach builds you up from there. No gym, no running experience needed.
If you have a hanging belly and it's your turn, try the run walk challenge. It starts Monday, November 9, and it's built for complete beginners.
